slots.title: Circle targets 40 new markets as stablecoin demand grows globally
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The stablecoin issuer’s CEO Jerermy Allaire told Reuters demand for digital dollars is growing across Asia, Africa and Latin America as banks and payment firms.

slots.title: Quantum Alliance forms amid warnings 6.4 million bitcoin face future quantum threat
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Nine crypto companies launched the Quantum Alliance to jointly prepare for quantum attacks, but they disagree on when the threat will arrive and whether vulnerable BTC should be frozen.

slots.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

slots.title: Solana’s Liu says Shanghai event postponed over registration surge
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Solana Foundation President Lily Liu said registrations quadrupled overnight, exceeding the attendance limit registered with local authorities.

slots.title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The crypto exchange already paid up, but a court order and restrictions from its 2025 settlement will not be lifted even though the CFTC said the case should have never been presented.
